name: Ping An Healthcare and Technology Company Limited
summary: Ping An Healthcare and Technology Company Limited (PAHT), established in 2014 and headquartered in Shanghai, runs an online healthcare platform in China through its subsidiaries. Services include virtual consultations, hospital referrals and appointments, inpatient care coordination and second opinions, plus consumer health packages from partner institutions. It also sells pharmaceuticals, supplements, medical devices and wellness goods, and offers health management programs, technology services and an insurance agency.
